text:
{
  "background_info": "Student Name: Pooja Sharma
School: Vidyasagar Institute, Mumbai
Grade: Grade 6
Date of IEP Meeting: 19 October 2026
Disability Classification: Locomotor Disability - Moderate Cerebral Palsy (Spastic Diplegia) under RPwD Act 2016 Section 16
Dominant Language: English and Hindi
Date Services Begin: 2 November 2026
Parent/Guardian: Mr. and Mrs. Sharma
Medical Alerts: Spastic diplegia affecting lower limbs requiring wheelchair mobility; fine motor speed constraints.",

  "academic_performance": "Present Level: Academic/Educational Achievement - Pooja Sharma is currently functioning at grade level across all academic subjects, demonstrating strong academic concept mastery with a historical score of 74% in Grade 5. Physical handwriting speed presents a barrier to traditional written output, but not cognitive understanding.
Present Level: Cognitive Ability - Pooja Sharma is currently functioning at grade level, demonstrating strong cognitive capabilities, reasoning, and problem-solving skills.
Present Level: Language Ability - Pooja Sharma is currently functioning at grade level in expressive and receptive language skills, showing high engagement and oral fluency during classroom discussions.
Present Level: Learning Style - Pooja Sharma is currently functioning at grade level using visual and auditory learning approaches, benefiting from verbal participation and digital content delivery.
Present Level: Rate of Progress - Pooja Sharma is currently functioning at grade level with a stable progress trajectory when supported by appropriate assistive tools.",

  "social_development": "Present Level: Relationships with Peers and Adults - Pooja Sharma is currently functioning at grade level, maintaining warm, positive relationships with classmates and teachers. She demonstrates high intrinsic motivation and confidence in peer interactions.
Present Level: Self-Concept and Social Adjustment - Pooja Sharma is currently functioning at grade level, showing excellent emotional resilience, strong self-advocacy, and active participation in collaborative learning groups without any behaviors that impede learning.",

  "physical_development": "Present Level: Motor and Sensory Development - Pooja Sharma is currently functioning below grade level in gross and fine motor skills due to spastic diplegia associated with moderate Cerebral Palsy. She utilizes a wheelchair for school navigation and experiences fine motor fatigue during extended manual writing.
Present Level: Health and Vitality - Pooja Sharma is currently functioning at grade level regarding overall health, maintaining consistent classroom stamina when provided with ergonomic desk positioning and planned physical breaks.",

  "management_needs": "Pooja requires a moderate degree of environmental modifications and specialized human and material resources to support physical accessibility and output adaptation.
Essential management needs include an adjustable-height desk suitable for wheelchair access, speech-to-text software, an ergonomic keyboard and mouse setup, barrier-free accessible physical pathways, and coordinated support from a special educator, occupational therapist, and physiotherapist.",

  "long_term_outcomes": "N/A — Student is below 14 years. Long-term adult outcomes and transition planning will be developed at age 14 per RPwD Act 2016 and NCTE Guidelines.",

  "annual_goals": "Annual Goal: Pooja will independently utilize speech-to-text software and adapted input devices to complete 100% of required written class assignments across academic subjects.
Short-term Objectives:
1. By the end of Term 1, Pooja will independently utilize speech-to-text software to complete short written paragraph responses with 80% accuracy in transcription as measured by teacher completed task logs.
2. By the end of Term 2, Pooja will independently utilize speech-to-text software and an ergonomic keyboard to draft multi-paragraph subject assignments with 85% accuracy in text output as measured by assignment rubrics.
3. By the end of Term 3, Pooja will independently complete all subject-area written assignments using speech-to-text software and digital tools within normal classroom timeframes across 90% of trials as measured by weekly work sample evaluations.
Evaluation Procedures: Teacher observation, completed task logs, work sample evaluation
Evaluation Schedule: Quarterly

Annual Goal: Pooja will independently navigate designated classroom, laboratory, and campus facility routes using wheelchair mobility within standard passing periods.
Short-term Objectives:
1. By the end of Term 1, Pooja will navigate from the classroom to the resource room and library using accessible ramp pathways within 5 minutes across 4 out of 5 observed trials as measured by therapist mobility checklists.
2. By the end of Term 2, Pooja will navigate all regular classroom and lab spaces using accessible routes within 4 minutes across 4 out of 5 observed transitions as measured by monthly mobility and accessibility checklists.
3. By the end of Term 3, Pooja will independently plan and execute wheelchair transition routes across all school campus areas within standard 3-minute class transition windows across 5 out of 5 trials as measured by mobility checklists.
Evaluation Procedures: Monthly mobility and accessibility checklists, physical therapist observation
Evaluation Schedule: Quarterly

Annual Goal: Pooja will maintain academic assignment and assessment scores above 75% across all core Grade 6 subjects utilizing prescribed testing and physical accommodations.
Short-term Objectives:
1. By the end of Term 1, Pooja will complete all Term 1 subject assessments using 25% extended time and speech-to-text software, achieving a score of 75% or higher in 4 out of 5 academic subject tests as measured by term report cards.
2. By the end of Term 2, Pooja will complete all Term 2 subject assessments in a separate quiet environment using ergonomic equipment, achieving a score of 75% or higher in all academic subject tests as measured by examination result logs.
3. By the end of Term 3, Pooja will maintain an overall term average of 75% or higher across all final Grade 6 examinations utilizing full accommodations as measured by term report cards.
Evaluation Procedures: Term report cards, examination result logs, standard grading rubrics
Evaluation Schedule: Quarterly",

  "special_education_services": "A. Special Education Programs: Specialised instruction by trained special educator provided in a resource room setting for 3 hours per week to support learning strategy adaptation and assistive technology software integration, beginning 2 November 2026 and continuing through 31 March 2027.

B. Extended School Year Services: No. Student demonstrates stable academic trajectory and does not display severe regression requiring extended year services.

C. Supplementary Aids and Modifications: Classroom and school infrastructure accessibility modifications with NCTE/NCERT Guidelines p. 30 and RPwD Act 2016 Section 16, including wheelchair ramps, wide door frames, and designated seating near the board. Access to allied health professionals such as physiotherapists and occupational therapists with NCTE/NCERT Guidelines p. 30 for 2 hours per week to support motor alignment, physical mobility, and ergonomic safety. Counselling or social-emotional support provided on a bi-weekly basis.

D. Assistive Technology Devices/Services: Provision of speech-to-text software, ergonomic keyboard and mouse setup, and adjustable-height desk with RPwD Act 2016 Section 16. Technical configuration and direct user training provided by special education personnel.

E. Program Modifications for School Personnel: Orientation for general education subject teachers on UDL principles, assistive technology integration, and physical positioning adaptations per NCTE/NCERT Guidelines p. 30.

F. Individual Testing Modifications: Extended time (minimum 25%) on all assessments (RPwD Act Section 17), separate, quiet testing environment, assistive technology as appropriate to disability, and use of speech-to-text tools during examinations.",

  "general_education_participation": "Pooja will participate fully in general education academic classes, group projects, and extracurricular activities alongside her peers for 100% of the school day, with assistive technology and physical accommodations. For Physical Education, Pooja will participate in adapted physical education activities designed in consultation with her physiotherapist to focus on range of motion and upper-body coordination.

No second-language exemption is granted or required, as Pooja demonstrates equal academic mastery and cognitive capability across all languages in her grade curriculum.",

  "participating_agencies": "N/A — Transition services not yet applicable. Will be identified at age 14.",

  "coordinated_activities": "1. Instruction: Standard Grade 6 general education curriculum utilizing UDL accommodations and speech-to-text software.
2. Related Services: Access to allied health professionals such as physiotherapists and occupational therapists with NCTE/NCERT Guidelines p. 30, along with counselling support.
3. Employment/Post-secondary Education: N/A at age 12.
4. Community Experience: Inclusive participation in school field trips and social events utilizing accessible transport facilities per NCTE/NCERT Guidelines p. 32.
5. Activities of Daily Living: Independent wheelchair mobility and campus navigation training.
6. Functional Vocational Assessment: N/A at age 12.",

  "graduation_info": "Certificate Sought: CBSE Secondary School Certificate.
Expected Year of Completion: 2033.
Board Examination Provisions: Reasonable accommodations under RPwD Act 2016 Section 16, including 25% extended time, separate quiet examination room, and use of speech-to-text software or computer access. No second-language exemption is required as Pooja meets all standard academic language requirements.",

  "recommendations_summary": "Disability Classification: Locomotor Disability - Moderate Cerebral Palsy per RPwD Act 2016 Section 16.
Recommended Placement: Full inclusion in Grade 6 general education classroom at Vidyasagar Institute, Mumbai, supported by resource instruction, therapy services, and physical accommodations.
Extended School Year Services: Not recommended.
Transportation Needs: Accessible school transport equipped with wheelchair access and safety restraints per NCTE/NCERT Guidelines p. 32.
Annual Review Date: 19 October 2027.",

  "progress_reporting": "Manner and Frequency of Progress Reporting: Progress will be reported to parents at the same frequency as non-disabled peers, through formal quarterly report cards four times per academic year.

Methods and Criteria: Evaluation methods include software usage logs, monthly therapist checklists, work sample assessments, and term test scores against SMART goal targets.

Parent Meeting Schedule: Formal parent-teacher conferences will occur at the conclusion of each term (Quarterly) to review objective progress and refine accommodations."
}
